fixes.find: that Li Si's eunuch illness was healed on the spot
fixes.reason: Japanese 病閹 is an eunuch-like condition, not an illness of a eunuch, as the bible glosses it.
fixes.replace: that Li Si's eunuch-like illness was healed on the spot

fixes.find: when they take a schooling and the like
fixes.reason: Take a schooling is unidiomatic and a good writer would not sign it; Japanese うける is receive or undergo.
fixes.replace: when they receive schooling and the like

fixes.find: as a tingling everywhere — this is not the misery of prickly heat.
fixes.reason: No dash in the Japanese at this join; the stray dash merges two source sentences and reads as machine prose.
fixes.replace: as a tingling everywhere. This is not the misery of prickly heat.

fixes.find: of the walled fields counted at three hundred mu
fixes.reason: Same term as the quotation in p10, where 負郭 is fields by the walls, not walled fields.
fixes.replace: of the fields by the walls counted as three hundred mu

data.say: Final read found only local wording, continuity and dash issues; the tableau, cure and undecided close all hold.
data.verdict: Ready after the listed fixes, which restore idiom, term continuity and dash discipline with no change to voice or crux.
